what: Plays C64 SID music from HVSC on an emulated 6581 or 8580 and lets you remix every voice live: transpose from the keys, mute, solo, swap waveforms, bend envelopes and the filter, add LFOs, ride the tempo and a vinyl fader. Out of the jack, as USB audio, or over ASID to a real SID.
author: thomasj (tubesockor)
